description: Transportnetværk, veje is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Klimadatastyrelsen. This INSPIRE dataset shows land transport routes for cars. Data can be used alone or in combination with other data from Denmark and Europe for planning and analysis. Coverage: Klimadatastyrelsen. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE - Transport network, roads" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Klimadatastyrelsen. Its keywords include transport, Transportnet, Transport. The listing shows 3 download or service links in GPKG, WMS. The listing shows 2026-09-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
